guide.why: A catch-all that discards the error hides a failure nobody has named.
guide.corrective_move: Catch only the error you can name; recover, add context and re-raise, or log the traceback at a boundary that must stay alive.
guide.expected_outcome: The failure is visible to whoever is on call, and the catch states a decision.
guide.avoid: Narrowing the type or adding a suppression comment while the error is still discarded.
